d:
Something about getting a coffin for the person you're trying to get revenge on, as well as yourself. Are you prepared for the aftermath? The consequences?

Hazuma Ryuukoro, after getting revenge and getting the chance to plow the girl he loves, believed that he was prepared for the consequences. However...

"Never Out-Villain A Villain."

The evil villainess of a private academy, a student council president and heir to its rulership. Maya Akuyaku will take him and set him straight.
